correctness.rationale: Splitting d|3^t m by 3-adic exponent gives exact D_s=(T_t-1/2)S_s-C_s/2. For negative s, each p≡2 mod3 Euler character factor is strictly positive and smaller than the ordinary factor, hence 0<C_s(m)<=S_s(m), with equality precisely if no p≡2 occurs. The geometric sum T_t gives uniform negativity for s<=-1 and sharp mixed signs for -1<s<0 by divergence of sum_{p≡2 mod3}p^s; multiplying by p≡1 creates infinitely many same-fibre examples. Successors coprime to 3 are always negative, yielding adjacent reversals. For s>=0 direct inequalities settle signs including s=0 boundary. Summing over divisors, the absolutely convergent coefficient c_s=1/2((3^s-1)ζ(1-s)-L(1-s,χ3))<0 follows for s<0 with stated error estimates. Independently compared direct divisor sums against character factorization for 249 n and 4 integer exponents; the analytic divergence and convergence are the infinite proof.
